scope: User-authorized separate descriptive single-stock range screen; not original H1/H2 factors or economic-return backtest
structural_events: Share bonuses/transfers, rights, reorganizations and unexplained reference changes block primary inclusion. Cash dividends annotated; quote-return chain used to avoid counting mechanical ex-cash drops as market traversals. Ledger/reference diagnostics are retrospective quality checks, not a claim of point-in-time investability.
name_policy: Last whole historical industry publication available by asof; display only; membership not required for selection
primary: All quote quality, liquidity, shape, first-half frozen-band confirmation and structural integrity conditions pass
score: 100*mean(clip(1-abs_trend/0.35),clip(1-center_drift/0.25),clip(1-boundary_drift/0.35),clip(traversals/12),second_half_frozen_band_coverage,active_quote_coverage), all clips [0,1]; primary candidates sorted score descending then symbol ascending
forward_data_limit: 2023-12-31; incomplete horizons not evaluated; retain every original candidate
forward_persistence: Frozen full-window band; at least 95% valid active quotes, at least 80% of valid closes inside band, no run of 10 market sessions outside [0.99*L,1.01*U]. Structural disturbance => not comparable, low coverage => unknown, neither counts as success. Missing sessions break breach runs and stay in coverage denominator.
interpretation: Nominal unadjusted quoted-price morphology; not economic returns, a buy signal, probability of future mean reversion or a current stock recommendation. Known snapshot coverage/survivorship limits remain. No threshold adjustment based on results.
